high_level_description: The image shows two individuals posing together against a plain, textured beige wall. The person on the left has shoulder-length blonde hair and is wearing a sleeveless denim vest over a black top and dark jeans with a patch pocket. They have their hands in their pockets and are looking slightly to the side with a relaxed posture. The person on the right has dark hair and is wearing a red long-sleeved blouse with a deep neckline and light gray high-waisted pants. They are holding a small, round object that resembles a skull or a decorative stone ball with a face carved into it.
